children: Labcorp Holdings warned CMS preliminary PAMA rates would impose steep cuts and reaffirmed its 2026–2029 long-term outlook.
CMS released preliminary Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule rates for 2027–2029 under PAMA; Labcorp says data used are not fully representative.
Company warns proposed rates would cause steep annual payment cuts that could threaten patient access to lab services.
Labcorp supports the bipartisan RESULTS Act as a solution to ensure a sustainable, innovative lab system.
Reaffirms 2026–2029 outlook: 5–8% CAGR revenue; 75–150 bps adjusted operating margin expansion by end of 2029; 8.5–11.5% CAGR adjusted EPS; FCF growth in line with adjusted earnings.

title: Labcorp Holdings says CMS PAMA rates threaten access; reaffirms 2026–2029 growth outlook
